Maya CS: Heads up renewal readiness ask for NovaCare. Renewal review Thurs. Need an SLO evidence packet (90/30/7d uptime), p50/p95 latency, incident brief, and a pre-filled credit calc for legal/finance. Can we get artifacts consolidated?

Ethan SRE: I can pull the rolling-window exports and incident timeline. Will include raw samples and the p95 tail. ETA today 3pm PT.

Priya Onboard: I have onboarding assets: runbook, slide deck, and session attendance. Will flag missed modules and provide catch-up dates.

Maya CS: Great. Also include a short note about recent mitigation we applied (model routing change) so execs understand what happened.

Ethan SRE: Quick numbers from monitoring:

```
90d uptime: 99.96%
30d uptime: 99.99%
7d uptime: 100%
p50 gen: 108ms
p95 gen: 390ms
incidents last 90d: 1 - 12m regional latency spike (Feb 9)
```

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-4777 and attached SLO export stub (https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-4777)

Jordan Sales: Note that NovaCare emphasized avoiding any unexpected credits; propose conservative calc and an explanation of contract clauses.

Olga Legal: I will verify the credit calculation against the 30-day lookback clause and cap rules. Add contract references in the calc doc.

Nora CS: I'll draft a 1-page executive summary and the customer-facing email. Will include recommended next steps and two enablement time slots.

Maya CS: Timeline: artifacts consolidated by today 3pm, internal review 4:30pm, customer email Thurs 9am. Sound good?

Ethan SRE: Yes. Uploading CSVs to ticket by 2:30pm.

Priya Onboard: Slides + attendance CSV by 1:30pm.

Jordan Sales: I'll review the credit wording by 4pm.

Olga Legal: I'll sign off by 4:45pm if contract refs included.

Maya CS: Thanks team. Once pack is ready, Ill post the assembled artifacts here and loop Sam (account owner).

(End of thread)
